name: Natsu no Owari ni...
source:
Hero is taking tutorship in order to enter a special prestigious school. His childhood friend was supposed to tutor him during summer, but hero's mother forced the decision to hire several women tutors on various science subjects. How far will he progress by the end of the studies with studies and relations?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公正在接受课外辅导，准备考入一所特殊的名门学校。原本说好由青梅竹马在暑假期间辅导他，母亲却强行决定另请几名女家庭教师，分别教授不同的理科科目。课程结束时，他的学业与人际关系究竟能取得多大进展？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
